_comment: How an address is written in this country, BELOW the lowest level in
levels.json. Everything at or above that level is already identified by a
P-code and must never be repeated here as text — a stored 'Tahtay Adiyabo,
North Western, Tigray' is the pcode's ancestry frozen at write time, and it
goes stale the day a woreda is renamed or resplit.
So: the P-code says WHICH unit, and this file says what is written below it.
The two never overlap, and only one of them can drift.
The shape is country data for the same reason code lists are. Ethiopia ends
at kebele and house number, has no residential street names, and does not
use postal codes for delivery. A pack that hardcoded 'street, city, ZIP'
would force every one of those to be invented here.
_lines_comment: How the parts compose into the flat address lines a registry stores.
Placeholders are sub_level ids; a line whose parts are all absent is
omitted rather than emitted blank. Ethiopia fills one line and leaves the
second empty — which is the point: address_line_2 ends up NULL instead of
carrying something invented to fill it.
